name: nn-agent-skills
description: Review lenses (adversarial, performance, risk, test coverage, dead code), run every installed lens for the findings alone, walk the changes one at a time, or render the whole review as one HTML page, plus evolutionary code optimization against a fitness function.

interface.shortDescription: Adversarial, performance, risk, test-coverage, and dead-code review lenses; walkthroughs and HTML reports; evolutionary optimization.
interface.longDescription: Ships adversarial-review, performance-code-review, risk-assessment, test-coverage-code-review, and dead-code-code-review lenses, and runs every code-review lens installed in the environment over a branch or working-tree diff for merged findings. Walk a branch or working-tree diff one logical change at a time in the terminal, drafting GitHub comments or applying verified fixes — or render the whole review as one self-contained HTML page with an overview, a GitHub-style diff, and per-change findings. Also generates diverse code mutations, evaluates them in isolated worktrees, and retains the strongest verified candidates in a MAP-Elites archive.
defaultPrompt: Review this branch and just tell me what the problems are.
Run an adversarial review of this PR.
Assess the shipping risk of this change.
Is this PR tested enough? Review test coverage.
Find dead code in this branch and propose removals.
Review this branch interactively, one change at a time.
Review this branch and give me the review as a web page.
Review my local changes and fix the problems.
Optimize this function against a benchmark with Evolve.
